QuestInfo.name: Where is the Dropship?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 47,914\nCan proceed to The Pilot's Whereabouts... quest\n
QuestInfo.1: You've safely deliver the letter from #bPorter#k in Omega Sector Command Center to #bKay#k in the Silo. You totally thought it was a juicy love letter, but...it was only about the Dropship that went missing. Kay asked you to find the Dropship near #b#m221030401##k, which can be accessed from #b#m221030400##k, and see if the pilot is still there.
QuestInfo.2: I found an empty dropship at the Boswell Field, and it appeared to have mistakenly landed here. The pilot is nowhere to be found; a letter was found instead.

0.0: Oh my goodness! The Dropship that had been reported missing may have been found! The members had a huge mission to carry on, and they were on their way back to the Sector when we lost them, and we had no idea where they were from that point on. I can't believe the Dropship is found now! Alright, here's your next task on hand.
0.1: According to the letter you just received, the Dropship's location signal is coming from #b#m221030401##k, which is accessible from #b#m221030400##k. Hurry to the area and find the Dropship and its pilot. It doesn't really matter what happened to the Dropship, but we should save the pilot if we can!

1.0: #b(Is this machine the Dropship that Kay mentioned?)
